evidence.quote: The U.S. economy still faces challenges, but I am convinced that the forceful actions of the Federal Reserve in 2008 helped prevent what clearly would have been a far worse scenario.
we moved beyond traditional monetary policy to purchase longer-term assets and push down longer-term interest rates.
And when I see the small business owners that I used to lend to, they tell me that they could not have survived the downturn without low rates.
For more than three years now, our policies have held short-term interest rates close to zero.

parsed.rationale: This is a largely biographical and institutional speech that reviews past crisis actions approvingly. It offers no forward guidance or current inflation view, though its favorable framing of low rates and asset purchases gives a slight dovish tilt.
